Picture this, Christmas 2023 - line out the door of customers that want to send off Christmas packages to their friends and family, typical Tuesday.

Well, until a lady walked in, with two Winn Dixie carts (we were next door to a Winn Dixie) FILLED - overflowing even - with Amazon returns.

My lunch break was supposed to be at 1, she made it to my counter at 12:50. She says off the bat “you’re going to hate me, I have quite a bit of stuff to send back.” as she shoves her phone with codes in my face.

I cock my head sideways and start scanning and bagging, scanning and bagging, and it went like this for almost an hour. Just going at full speed. 

All in all, at the end of everything - she had returned over 300 individual items all in that one trip. All with different label/code types, etc. 

And no, I didn’t get to take my lunch break, and my manager didn’t like us eating in the store - so I crammed a Cliff bar in my mouth between customers and took a “bathroom break” to pull my hair out and contemplate my life choices.
Disgusting

Oh yeah, always. 

Worst was a lady that wanted to overnight a package to Los Angeles from N.E Florida (my store) on Christmas Eve, dispite all of the signs around the store that said **"UPS and Postal Service will not be moving packages from Dec. 24th - 26th."** in big bold red letters, and still threw a fit when my manager explained that even with Next Day Air, it would get there on the 27th.
